summary: Iter57 RETEST after fixing the 2 CRITICAL blockers from iter56: (a) emergent_auth router prefix moved from /auth → /auth/emergent to end the collision with admin /auth/me; (b) usuarios indexes migrated to partialFilterExpression:{$type:'string'} with startup drop of legacy telefono_1/email_1/user_id_1. 23/23 pytest tests PASS (100%). Updated test file with new endpoint paths, index assertion (partialFilterExpression instead of sparse), added regression tests for admin /api/auth/me + new /api/auth/emergent/logout (4 new tests). Verified: new endpoints reachable (POST /api/auth/emergent/session, GET /api/auth/emergent/me, POST /api/auth/emergent/profile-setup, POST /api/auth/emergent/logout); admin /api/auth/me still returns {email, role} for admin token and 403s player JWT (regression clean); usuarios has telefono_partial_unique / email_partial_unique / user_id_partial_unique — insert_many of 2 docs with telefono=None succeeds (fix confirmed); user_sessions TTL index present; OTP end-to-end (request → verify with Mongo-fetched code → /auth/emergent/me → profile-setup → /me/roles) all green.
critical_code_review_comments: core/db.py:44-60 drop-and-recreate migration is one-shot but silent on failure (bare except: pass). Once verified stable in prod, consider logging index_information() diff at INFO level on first boot so ops can audit which legacy indexes were dropped.

routers/emergent_auth.py:212 _used_session_ids is still per-process in-memory — with multiple workers a duplicate could slip once per worker. Playbook-tolerable but a Mongo-backed dedup (unique on session_id hash + TTL) would be robust for prod.

routers/emergent_auth.py:_upsert_user_by_email finds by email only — an OTP legacy user (telefono set, email=None) who later Googles with the same real identity gets a second row. Consider secondary lookup by matched phone during upsert or a manual /admin/link endpoint.

rca_of_issue: Fixes verified: (1) Route collision — moving emergent router prefix to /auth/emergent means FastAPI no longer sees identical operation paths for admin vs player /me; both handlers coexist and route correctly by URL. Confirmed via TestAdminMeUnchanged.test_admin_me_returns_admin_data (admin JWT → {email,role} at /api/auth/me) and TestAuthMeHybridWithOtpToken.test_me_works_with_legacy_otp_jwt (player OTP JWT → UserPublic at /api/auth/emergent/me). (2) Index migration — startup drops legacy non-partial indexes and recreates as partialFilterExpression:{field:{$type:'string'}}, which is stricter than sparse (sparse still considers explicit null a value; partial filter with $type:string does not). Confirmed via TestDbSchemaIndexes.test_sparse_telefono_allows_multiple_null_emails (insert_many of 2 docs with telefono=None succeeds — this was the exact failure repro from iter56).
